recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current FHIR core source matches the final Jira decision; no follow-up is needed for FHIR-17152 unless a future naming policy changes this search parameter again.
issue_request: FHIR-17152 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for STU3 asking to rename the EpisodeOfCare search parameter from incomingreferral to incoming-referral according to FHIR search-parameter naming conventions.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied. Git commit 16b39173a7663c5240cfaed0333b54bef8ed04d7, titled 'Tracker 17152 added "-" to search parameter', changed the old EpisodeOfCare spreadsheet search row from incomingreferral to incoming-referral. The later source refactor in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved the renamed id, URL, and code in bundle-EpisodeOfCare-search-params.xml.
additional_context: EpisodeOfCare is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current authoritative search-parameter bundle has id EpisodeOfCare-incoming-referral, URL http://hl7.org/fhir/build/SearchParameter/EpisodeOfCare-incoming-referral, and code incoming-referral for EpisodeOfCare.referralRequest. PA minutes from 2018-08-07 record the same persuasive block-vote resolution. FHIR-17153 was encountered as a paired Encounter naming issue from the same block vote, but it concerns a different resource and already has its own combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The combined branch already contains an empty audit commit for FHIR-17152, and no duplicate commit was published after that commit appeared during local integration.
